Introduction

My intention in this practices is help you to make a connection to mysql from ElasticSearch and manage your queries like indices from kibana. It's important have a background in this tools, if you're new you can see this tutorials before.

  • MySQL
  • ElasticSearch

The tool to connect MySql with ElasticSearch is Logstash, is an open source data collection engine with real-time pipelining capabilities. Logstash can dynamically unify data from disparate sources and normalize the data into destinations of your choice.

Project Folder

The folder for this, looks like the image below and you can get it in my github

I'm going explain briefly what is each element

  • docker-compose.yaml: the compose file is taken from the ElasticSearch github and has the configuration to create a cluster with 3 master nodes and kibana. In addition there is two services, containers settings, the logstash and mysql services

  • .env: it comes with docker-compose file and is for set the environment variables of the .yaml

  • mysql-connector: this folder has a .deb file, it is installed when the losgtash container start and allows it make connection with MySql and push to ElasticSearch

  • logstash.conf: it has the settings for logstash to first make the connection and after insertion in the elasticsearch index

What Logstash Service Do?

If you open the compose file, the logstash service setting is

You can peek it, but there are two important things. First, map the mysql-connector folder and the logstash.conf file, that has the MySql query, into the container

Second is the command, this install the MySql connector in the logstash container, then run the logstash.conf.
